templates.title: Portrait
templates.description: A head-and-shoulders portrait with controlled studio or window light.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Head-and-shoulders portrait of [person: age, look, expression], wearing [clothing], against [background]. Soft key light from [direction], gentle fill, 85 mm lens, eyes in sharp focus.
defaults.negative: distorted hands, extra fingers, blurry eyes, heavy retouching

templates.title: Product shot
templates.description: A clean hero image of one product for a shop or an ad.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Hero shot of [product] in [colour or material], standing on [surface] in front of a [background colour] seamless backdrop. Three-quarter angle, softbox lighting with a clean rim light, a subtle reflection underneath, [prop or accent] beside it.

templates.title: Character sheet
templates.description: One character shown front, side and back on a plain background.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Character reference sheet of [character: age, build, hair, face], wearing [outfit]. Three full-body views side by side: front, side profile and back, same pose and scale. Plain light grey background, even lighting, consistent colours.
defaults.negative: different outfits between views, cropped feet, busy background

templates.title: Poster
templates.description: Key art for a film or an event, with room for the title.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Key art poster for [film or event]: [central figure or object] in [setting], dramatic [lighting] lighting, a strong silhouette, [colour palette]. Leave clean space at the [top or bottom] for the title.

templates.title: Landscape
templates.description: A wide scenic view for backgrounds, establishing shots or prints.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Wide landscape of [place] at [time of day], [weather]. A foreground of [foreground detail], with [midground feature] leading the eye toward [background feature]. Atmospheric depth, natural colour.

templates.title: Food photography
templates.description: An appetising dish styled for a menu, a blog or an ad.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Overhead food photograph of [dish], served on [plate or board] on a [table surface]. Garnish of [garnish], [side items] at the edges, soft daylight from the side, a little steam, shallow depth of field.
defaults.negative: plastic-looking food, messy plate, harsh flash
